# Venice Asourmatzian | Marketing Recipes

> Venice Asourmatzian is a marketing consultant and advisor, recognised by Campaign Media and WARC, who turns content, social, partnerships and creators into growth drivers. She helps in-house teams, fast-scaling brands and agencies under pressure as a fractional marketing lead, strategic advisor or project partner. Marketing Recipes LLC is her consultancy, based in Austin, Texas, working with clients worldwide.

Good marketing isn't magic. It's a recipe. Most brands already have the ingredients; what breaks is execution, when strategies that sound great in the boardroom fall apart in the real world.

For 12+ years Venice has worked at agency groups Publicis and WPP, and directly with Mars, Bayer and H&H Group, building billion-dollar brands and helping teams turn attention into measurable business outcomes across FMCG, beauty, food, wellness, travel and tech. Her work covers every channel that matters, from TV, OOH and retail media to creators, partnerships, product placements and celebrity endorsements. It lives in the messy middle between strategy and execution: building ideas, operating models and ways of working that help teams move faster and show up consistently.

## Services

- [Brand, Marketing & Go-to-Market Strategy](https://veniceasour.com/#services): Positioning, go-to-market, and the plan that follows. Brand positioning and audience definition, go-to-market plans for launches and market expansion, channel prioritisation, messaging frameworks and distinctive brand assets.
- [Content & Social Strategy](https://veniceasour.com/#services): Helping brands compete for attention in social-first feeds. Content pillars and editorial cadence, creator and partnership programmes, channel playbooks.
- [Integrated Marketing Campaigns](https://veniceasour.com/#services): One big idea, a thousand small executions. Campaign concept, creative direction, cross-channel and cross-market rollout, post-campaign review.
- [Marketing & Content Operations](https://veniceasour.com/#services): The teams, processes and tools that scale without chaos. Team design, workflow and approvals, agency and freelancer operating models, measurement.
- [Keynotes & Training](https://veniceasour.com/#services): Keynotes, panel moderation and event hosting, from intimate corporate sessions to global industry conferences, plus team training and leadership sessions on the future of marketing, social, community-led growth and the creator economy.

## Who she works with

- In-house brand and marketing teams
- Founders and fast-scaling brands
- Agencies and creative partners

## Selected case studies

- [eBay x Love Island](https://veniceasour.com/#work): Co-led the strategy positioning eBay as Love Island's official pre-loved fashion partner (at EssenceMediacom). 700% rise in searches, 935% increase in pre-loved mentions, 32.4% partnership recall, award-winning work.
- [TUI x The World Cook](https://veniceasour.com/#work): Co-led the strategy and production ecosystem for an Amazon Prime cooking series (at EssenceMediacom). Highest ROI across TUI media spend that year, 93.4% viewer approval, 10% increase in purchase intent.
- [Patch](https://veniceasour.com/#work): Rebuilt the content system around expertise, inspiration and personality. 149.7% increase in organic views, 35% uplift in watch time, 527% uplift in tracked social revenue month-on-month.
- [Mars Snacking](https://veniceasour.com/#work): One social-first operating model across a complex European portfolio, clearer narratives across brands, and reactive approvals fast enough to join cultural moments while they still mattered.
- [Zesty Paws](https://veniceasour.com/#work): Launched across four European markets (at H&H Group), with compliant messaging, ecommerce, a creator programme, TikTok Shop and an in-market team built from scratch.

Trusted by household names, challenger brands, and the agencies that build them: Mars, Snickers, M&M's, Maltesers, Twix, Extra, eBay, TUI, Patch, Zesty Paws, H&H Group, Bayer, Berocca, Canesten, Samsung, Coca-Cola, Mercedes-Benz, Nestlé, Nescafé, Disney+, Essity, Pantene, Head & Shoulders, Herbal Essences, Aussie, Heineken, Sainsbury's, McCormick, COTY, Gosh, Avon, Swisse, UBS, Brarista, University of Birmingham, Billion Dollar Boy, Publicis Media, WPP Media.
